in_sanskrit.name: Kantharaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the throat
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kantharaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kantha means throat and Raja means lord. This name is derived from the Hindu god Shiva, who is believed to control the throat chakra. It is believed that those named Kantharaj have the power to communicate effectively and persuasively.
